import socket,sys,time,json
import arena
b=arena.load_board()

s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX);s.connect('/run/match/opponent-stockfish.sock');f=s.makefile('r')
def cmd(x): s.sendall((x+'\n').encode())
cmd('uci')
for l in f:
 if l.strip()=='uciok':break
cmd('setoption name Threads value 2');cmd('setoption name Hash value 256');cmd('isready')
for l in f:
 if l.strip()=='readyok':break
cmd('position startpos moves '+' '.join(m.uci() for m in b.move_stack))
cmd('go movetime '+str(int(sec*1000)))
for l in f:
 if ' pv ' in l: last=l.strip()
 if l.startswith('bestmove'):
  print(last,flush=True);print(l.strip(),flush=True)
  open('analysis.json','w').write(json.dumps({'fen':b.fen(),'info':last,'bestmove':l.split()[1]}))
  break
cmd('quit')
